versions.content: Transmission error behavior In case of a PDID transmission error, the Dcm shall use always the same order of periodicDIDs per client. Transmission errors shall not influence this order, the Dcm shall continue to retry the transmission and start the next PDID only after the PDID was transmitted successfully.
